description: Ensure robots.txt is present and does not block important content
sitemap.xml or sitemap.ts must exist and include all indexable pages
Every page must have a canonical URL to prevent duplicate content
All resources served over HTTPS with valid certificate
not-found.tsx with helpful navigation links
No redirect chains longer than 2 hops
All important pages return 200 status
Lowercase hyphenated descriptive slugs
error.tsx for graceful server error handling
Unique title per page 50-60 chars with primary keyword
Unique description per page 150-160 chars with CTA
Exactly one H1 per page matching page topic
Sequential headings h1 to h2 to h3 no skips
Descriptive alt on meaningful images empty on decorative
Key pages linked from navigation with descriptive anchor text
og:title og:description og:image og:url on all pages
twitter:card twitter:title twitter:description twitter:image
Set in root layout for proper URL resolution
Use title.template in root layout for consistent branding
At least Organization and BreadcrumbList schemas
On blog posts and articles with required properties
On product pages with price and availability
On FAQ sections for rich result eligibility
All JSON-LD validates against schema.org
Largest Contentful Paint target
Interaction to Next Paint target
Cumulative Layout Shift target
next/image or responsive images with modern formats
next/font or font-display swap with preload
Dynamic imports for heavy components
